blocks.h2: Adding Gas to an Older Chicago Building
blocks.body: A new appliance in a century-old building is usually tied into piping that has been extended many times. Before adding a branch, we check that the existing line can carry the new load along with the furnace and water heater on the same meter. In a two-flat, we make sure we're on the right unit's system. The City of Chicago may require a permit for the work, and we'll handle it where it does.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a New Gas Line
blocks.body: The route through an older building and the distance from the right meter matter most. Outdoor lines and upper floors take more work. City permits may apply. We plan the route and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Gas Line Installation Questions From Ravenswood Homeowners

items.q: Can I move my dryer and keep it gas?
items.preview: Yes, with a new branch line.
items.answer: Yes. We run a new branch to the new location and cap the old one.

items.q: Can my old pipe handle a new range?
items.answer: We calculate the load and check the pipe before connecting.
Yes, where the city requires one.

items.q: Can you run gas to the backyard?
items.answer: Yes, with a protected line and a shutoff.

items.q: Can a gas line run outside the building?
items.answer: Yes, when it's properly supported and protected. It's common for grill lines.

items.q: Can you remove an old gas line?
items.answer: Yes. We cap it properly and pressure-test the system.

items.q: How much does gas line installation cost in Ravenswood?
items.preview: It depends on the run. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the length of the run, the appliance and the route. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
